The covered startup theorem keeps the ENTIRE old 6435-byte declaration, all original admissions and the full old return contract. The old producer runs once. For EVERY actual emitted output, its SAME ResourceHistory constructs an actual finite partial root read. Bound, partial term and full after-state precede all semantic models. Every larger bound gives the same raw singleton. Full own Packet/Caller/Inventory/Memos/metadata and dependency levels stay before and after. Under Satisfies of that OWN output, the same assignment remains satisfying and existing Completes represents its root value. No Discharged gate is needed. This does not produce an output or derive its model from original acceptance. Raw holes and intentional recursive truncation remain.

The partial operation reuses the existing worker and completion predicate. A private actual-lookup recursive-boundary tag is only an observation adapter, with no graph-language/intersection correspondence claim. Program-hole membership now derives ProgramAt and avoidance transport. A checked pure type-hole witness shows why original root encoding alone does not provide program provenance for arbitrary annotation holes; it is no native execution or Haskell failure.

SelectedValue.run performs exactly ONE repaired stored Mu unfolding, or actual repaired Union row read plus node reconstruction. Original SemanticReady/Available/closed derive one stable actual result and heap, Keeps/semantic readiness/closure and exact independent least-language equivalence. It retains failure heaps in the existing result type. It is still a standalone native operation: no allocated Caller/Post/full-Memos lift, selected dispatch, slot write or resource forecast integration is claimed. Haskell already performs these preparation operations. Existing Lean ordinary continuation has the known ordinary/nonterminal shape restriction. ProperState excludes terminal stored SOME buckets, so no proper-startup terminal-fallback reachability is claimed. Proper nonempty descendant Mu/Union candidates still require normalization. Empty recursive buckets intentionally yield opaque DONE outputs. No Haskell defect or required patch is newly established. No Haskell/Cabal edit, test or benchmark ran.
